name: income-per-sed-quality
description: Release validation and visual regression for Income-per-sed.

scripts.test:release: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_prepare_delivery.py && node --test tests/release-channel.test.mjs tests/workflow-contract.test.mjs tests/release-naming.test.mjs tests/install-ci-dependencies.test.mjs
scripts.test:readme: node --test tests/readme-preview-validation.test.mjs && node scripts/validate-readme-previews.mjs && npm run test:docs
scripts.test:checks: npm run test:release && npm run test:widget && npm run test:readme && npm run build:check && npm run validate
scripts.test:recovery: playwright test --config=config/playwright-edge.config.js tests/foreground-resume.spec.js tests/foreground-progress.spec.js tests/readout-sync.spec.js tests/cross-date-month.spec.js tests/recovery-combinations.spec.js tests/recovery-cross-actions.spec.js tests/browser-lifecycle.spec.js
scripts.test:settings: playwright test --config=config/playwright-edge.config.js tests/motion-feedback.spec.js tests/settings-local-motion.spec.js tests/settings-scrollbar-handoff.spec.js tests/settings-refinements.spec.js tests/settings-stability.spec.js tests/settings-input-safety.spec.js tests/settings-text-continuity.spec.js tests/storage-resilience.spec.js
scripts.quality:local: npm run test:release && npm run release:prepare && npm run test:readme && npm run test:widget && npm test && npm run test:webkit
